description_zh: 调用ListApplicationMonitor接口查询源站探测任务列表
kebab_example: aliyun ga list-application-monitor --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --search-value aliyun --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplicationMonitor

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator (GA) instance is deployed. Set the value to cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所属的地域，仅取值：cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数。最大值：100。默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used to search for origin probing tasks. You can enter a URL, an IP address, a GA instance ID, or a listener ID to perform a fuzzy match
parameters.help_zh: 源站探测任务搜索关键字。支持按照URL、IP地址、全球加速实例ID和监听ID模糊搜索
parameters.name: search_value

ApplicationMonitors.description_en: The list of origin probing tasks

AcceleratorId.description_en: The ID of the GA instance on which the origin probing task runs
AcceleratorId.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应的全球加速实例ID

Address.description_en: The URL or IP address that was probed

DetectEnable.description_en:
Indicates whether the automatic diagnostics feature is enabled. Valid values:

true

false
DetectEnable.description_zh:
是否开启了自动诊断功能。

true：是。

false：否

DetectThreshold.description_en: The threshold that is used to trigger the automatic diagnostics feature

DetectTimes.description_en: The number of times that are required to reach the threshold before the automatic diagnostics feature can be triggered
DetectTimes.description_zh: 触发自动诊断需要达到触发阈值的次数

ListenerId.description_en: The ID of the listener on which the origin probing task runs
ListenerId.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应的监听实例ID

OptionsJson.description_en: The extended options of the listener protocol that is used by the origin probing task. The options vary based on the listener protocol
OptionsJson.description_zh: 源站探测任务对应监听协议类型的高级扩展选项。不同源站探测任务的监听协议类型对应不同的扩展选项

SilenceTime.description_en:
The silence period of the automatic diagnostics feature. This parameter indicates the interval at which the automatic diagnostics feature is triggered. If the availability rate does not return to normal after GA triggers an automatic diagnostic task, GA must wait until the silence period ends before GA can trigger another automatic diagnostic task.

If the number of consecutive times that the availability rate drops below the threshold of automatic diagnostics reaches the value of DetectTimes , the automatic diagnostics feature is triggered. The automatic diagnostics feature is not triggered again within the silence period even if the availability rate stays below the threshold. If the availability rate does not return to normal after the silence period ends, the automatic diagnostics feature is triggered again.

Unit: seconds
SilenceTime.description_zh:
自动诊断触发沉默时间。表示自动诊断触发后，未恢复到正常，间隔多久触发一次自动诊断。

可用率连续多次（即设置的DetectTimes）低于自动诊断触发阈值时，触发自动诊断，如果可用率在自动诊断触发沉默时间内持续低于自动诊断触发阈值，在自动诊断触发沉默时间内不会重复出发自动诊断；如果可用率在自动诊断触发沉默时间后仍未恢复正常，则再次触发自动诊断。

单位：秒

State.description_en:
The status of the origin probing task. Valid values:

active: The origin probing task is running.

inactive: The origin probing task is stopped.

init: The origin probing task is being initialized.

deleting: The origin probing task is being deleted
State.description_zh:
源站探测任务状态。

active：启用。

inactive：停用。

init：初始化。

deleting：删除中

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
